us.title: Video shows students saving their school bus, driver: "Our bus driver just passed out"
us.desc: A school bus security camera caught quick-thinking students leaping into action after they noticed the bus driver limp over the steering wheel. Tom Hanson has the story.

us.title: Jack Smith Defends Trump Charges as Senator’s Perjury Claim Falls Apart
us.desc: A Republican eager to prove the former special counsel was dishonest appeared to instead demonstrate his own confusion over basic facts.

us.title: British authorities defend decision to let terror suspects go on bail
us.desc: British authorities defended their decision to let a group of young men go free, even as investigators look into a suspected terror plot near an air base there that was used by the U.S. military in its war against Iran. Ramy Inocencio reports from London.

us.title: Trump agrees to let AI leaders police themselves
us.desc: President Trump said he sees no need for the government to rein in or slow down artificial intelligence development. After meeting with a group of major tech leaders on Tuesday, he stuck with that position. Nancy Cordes has more.

us.title: Lindsay Clancy's attorney argues for the first time that there's no evidence she killed her kids
us.desc: Lindsay Clancy was back in court on Tuesday, her first appearance since a mistrial was declared earlier this month. Clancy's attorney argued for the first time that there is no evidence that Clancy killed her three small children, something he did not dispute
